```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("rest_inspec")
```

```{r}
rest_inspec = 
    rest_inspec |> 
    rename(borough = boro)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot: Map of Graded Manhattan Restaurants

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    borough == "Manhattan",
    !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude), !is.na(grade),
    longitude != 0, latitude != 0) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Name: ", dba, "\nGrade: ", grade)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5)
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Box Plot: Distribution of Restaurant Scores Across Boroughs 

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  filter(borough != "0") |> 
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~borough, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Score (Lower Scores Reflect Higher Grades)"))
```

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Bar Chart: Thai Restaurants with an A Grade Across Boroughs 

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  filter(
    cuisine_description == "Thai", 
    grade == "A") |> 
  distinct(camis, borough) |> 
  count(borough) |>  
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~borough, y = ~n, type = "bar", color = ~borough, colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Thai Restaurants with an A Grade"))
```
